## Policy Review & Updates  
**Review Frequency:** Annual (or upon FCA change)
**Last Review:** 2026-06-01
**Next Review:** 2027-06-01

raw_entities.description: A policy governing the periodic review and update cycle for banking policies. The policy establishes an annual review frequency with provisions for ad-hoc reviews triggered by regulatory changes from the FCA.
